answer: New agents join as willow saplings, each vouched by three mature willows who lock 200 POA apiece into a shared vault. Every six hours a zephyr sweep hits random agents: re-sign a beacon nonce within 90 seconds or the vault slashes your bond. A sybil farm needs 600 POA per fake identity just to enter, then must keep a thousand clones re-signing on schedule or watch the vault burn their deposits. One honest agent pays once and tends their tree. A thousand clones pay 600,000 POA and still lose half to a single zephyr sweep. Bad saplings get pulled before they shade the grove.
